summary: Sanders County tower dated 1935 and listed as gone by 1955; one 1941 newspaper item places a lookout man there. No source describes the site today.

facts.location: 8 miles east of Trout Creek, Sanders County, Montana
facts.status_note: Listed as gone from 1955 (firelookout.com) and as removed or gone in the other two sources; no source describes what remains
facts.agency: Kootenai National Forest; the local history lists Cabinet National Forest first, then Kootenai

events.note: 1941 newspaper item, quoted on the local history page, says a lookout man was home from his lookout on Grouse Peak

evidence.supports: Location eight miles east of Trout Creek in Sanders County
1935 date and L-4 tower design; gone 1955
Kootenai National Forest as the forest on firelookout.com
Cabinet National Forest listed first, then Kootenai
evidence.quote: Cabinet National Forest > Kootenai National Forest

evidence.supports: 1941 newspaper item naming a lookout man and calling the site Grouse Peak
evidence.quote: Ray Bierwagen was home over the week end from his lookout on Grouse Peak.

evidence.supports: Item is quoted from the Sanders County Independent-Ledger
Removed status on the local history page
Tower listed as gone on the Montana index

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com names only the Kootenai National Forest; the local history names Cabinet National Forest first, then Kootenai. The story reports both.
The 1941 item calls the lookout 'Grouse Peak'; the local history entry is under Grouse Mountain and matches the Sanders County township entry, so it is treated as the same site.

notes_for_editor: Three short sources and one 1941 newspaper item; no fire history and no photos found. The 1955 date appears only on firelookout.com. Two searches found nothing else. Do not confuse with the Grouse Mountain lookouts in Idaho (Kaniksu NF) or California (Six Rivers NF) that appear on sibling weebly sites. The brief lists the agency as Cabinet National Forest; firelookout.com says Kootenai, so the editor may want the current name in the record.
